help.clanCard.description.player: This card reminds you that {playerName} belongs to the {clan} clan. Should {playerName} take a power token, it will also be located on this card. Each team can only have one power token at any given time. Once a team has a power token, they must use it before taking a new token, they cannot swap power tokens. The leader token will also be located on the right side of the card when given to {playerName}.
help.clanCard.description.self: This card reminds you that you belong to the {clan} clan. Should you take a power token, it will also be located on this card. Each team can only have one power token at any given time. Once a team has a power token, they must use it before taking a new token, they cannot swap power tokens. The leader token will also be located on the right side of the card when given to you.

help.kitsuCard.blackKitsune.description: This card compels the next player, clockwise, to play a card of the color of your clan. If this player doesn't have any card of your clan's color, they may play a card from their clan or a special card.

help.kitsuCard.katana.description: The player who plays this card flips face down a numeral card (1 to 6) played face up in front of another player. The card flipped face down will not count for the current trick.

help.kitsuCard.whiteKitsune.description: This card swaps the colors of the numeral cards for the current trick. The blue cards become orange and vice-versa. The effects of the White Kitsune cards are cumulative with each other and with the relevant power token.
help.kitsuCard.whiteKitsune.title: White Kitsune card
help.kitsunePawn.description.myTeam: The Kitsune pawn of your team. Your team wins a round when advancing this pawn to the last spot on the Wisdom track .
help.kitsunePawn.title: Kitsune Pawn
help.leaderToken.description.player: This token indicates that {playerName} is the leader for the trick and that they will play the first card of the trick. It will then pass to the player on their left at the end of the trick.
help.leaderToken.description.self: This token indicates that you are the leader for the trick and that you will play the first card of the trick. It will then pass to the player on your left at the end of the trick.
help.leaderToken.title: Leader Token
help.powerToken.colourExchange.descripti: When played, the colors of the of the numeral cards are swapped. The blue cards become orange and vice-versa. The effect of this token is cumulative with White Kitsune cards' effect..
help.powerToken.noAdvance.description: When played, the clan that wins the trick does not advance their Kitsune pawn (regardless of the clan who played it)
help.powerToken.pickDiscarded.descriptio: The player who played this token can look at the {numberOfCardsToReveal} discarded cards from the last trick, pick one card of their choice and add it to their hand.
This player will then have one more card than the other players for the time being. As soon as the other players run out of cards, this player will discard their remaining card.
help.powerToken.plus3.description: Double-sided: The player who played this token chooses a side to add +3 to the Orange or the Blue clan. This token is affected by the effects of the White Kitsune card and color swapping power token.
help.powerToken.protection.description: The player who played this Power token plays its card face down and puts its token above, this card is protected from the Katana card. This card will be revealed at the end of the trick.
help.powerToken.protection.description.c: This token cannot be played on top of the Katana or Black Kitsune cards.
help.powerToken.title: Power Token
help.powerToken.unavailableForRound: This token is unavailable because it already has been used during this round. It will become available again at the beginning of the next round.
help.setupCard.description: This card show how the {numberOfPlayers} players are placed around the table.
help.setupCard.title: Setup Card
help.victoryCard.description.other: This card indicates that the opposing team ({clan}) has won a round. The opposing team needs to win two rounds to win the game.
help.victoryCard.description.self: This card indicates that your team ({clan}) has won a round. Your team needs to win two rounds to win the game.
help.victoryCard.title: Victory Card
help.wisdomBoard.description.deck: At the left hand side of the board lies the deck pile (only for a 2 players game).
help.wisdomBoard.description.discard: At the right hand side of the board lies the discard pile. Cards in the discard pile are faced down and cannot be looked at by players.
help.wisdomBoard.description.wisdomTrack: At the center of the board lies the wisdom track. At the beginning of the round, both Kitsune pawn are placed on the leftmost spot of the track. At the end of each trick, the team with the highest sum of Kistu cards advances their Kitsune pawn on the track a number of spaces equal to the difference between the two teams' card sum. Once a Kitsune pawn reaches the last spot on the wisdom track (called the Ultimate Wisdom), the according team wins the round. The game ends when a team wins two rounds.
help.wisdomBoard.title: Wisdom Board

tuto.board: This is the <bold>Wisdom board</bold>. Your goal is to have your <bold>Kitsune pawn</bold> reach the end of the track to win the round. The first clan to <bold>win 2 rounds</bold> wins the game.
tuto.card.whiteKitsune: Here is the last special card, the <bold>White Kitsune</bold>. It can overthrow a round because it swaps the colors of the numeral cards for the current trick: <bold>orange cards become blue and vice-versa</bold>!
tuto.cards: Here is your hand of <bold>Kitsu cards</bold>.
tuto.cards.numberPerTrick:
When playing a 2-player game, you'll play 2 cards each trick.
<italic>When playing a 4 or 6-player game, each player only plays one card each trick.</italic>
tuto.cards.numeral: There are cards of both clans, each having a value ranging from 1 to 6.
tuto.cards.special: There are also special cards (3 kinds, 2 cards of each kind), which we'll cover later.
tuto.end:
At any given time, you can click on a card, a pawn or a token to know their effect, and how many of this items are in the game.
Now it's your time to play, good luck and have fun!
tuto.game.interrupt.endOfTrick:
Once 4 cards are played, the trick will end.
<bold>Each clan's points are then tallied.</bold> The winning Clan moves their Kitsune pawn forward a number of spots equal to the difference between the two clans' scores.
tuto.game.interrupt.endOfTrick.kitsunePa: Here, the orange Kitsune Pawn moves <orange>8</orange> - <blue>5</blue> = <bold>3 spots</bold>.
tuto.game.interrupt.endOfTrick2:
The opposing Clan moves their Kitsune pawn <bold>4 spots</bold> forward.
When the opposing clan's pawn move 4 spaces or more, you can take a <bold>Power token</bold>, provided your clan doesn't own one already.
tuto.game.interrupt.endOfTrick3: You win this trick and move your pawn forward 2 spots.
tuto.game.play.me.card1: This is your turn. Play this card.

tuto.game.play.me.katana:
This special card, the <bold>Katana</bold>, allows you to remove a numeral card played by another player.
Play it and slay the opponent's card.
tuto.game.play.me.pickPlus3Token:
Take this token. When you will play it, you will be able to add +3 to the clan of your choice.
<italic>At any given time, you can click on a token to know its effect.</italic>
